prompt: Can I afford to spend $300 on a concert ticket tomorrow?

turns.text:
Not from checking alone. Checking has $1,672.69 now, so the ticket itself would clear tomorrow. But the forecast already has checking dropping to $62.59 after rent on Wed, Oct 14. It goes below the $50.00 floor on Thu, Oct 15 and reaches -$304.29 on Sun, Oct 18, before your next payday on Mon, Oct 19. A $300 ticket would make that gap deeper.

Rainy Day Savings has $3,800.00 and could cover the gap. Do you want me to move money from savings to checking to cover both the existing shortfall and the ticket?
